methods.name: Giants' Foundry: bronze/iron
methods.note: Reference pace assumes optimal moulds (up to 81 Smithing), average commissions, no Smiths' Uniform and good play. Enter the sword quality to estimate hand-in XP; forging action XP is additional. Bars and equipment contribute material equivalents; a battleaxe contributes 2 bars.
preparation: Bring bars or suitable metal equipment and choose a two-metal alloy.
Pick moulds that match Kovac's commission.
loop: Fill the crucible and pour the sword mould.
Heat or cool the sword into each tool's working band and follow the indicated tool sequence.
Deliver the sword and buy useful mould upgrades before the next commission.
milestones: Forge one sword without damaging its quality.
Complete five commissions and record final quality.
Unlock better moulds; compare the next eligible alloy at50,70 or85 Smithing.
methods.attention: Manual inputs throughout the method.

methods.name: Mastering Mixology
methods.note: 45k at level 81 without speedups; about 70k with all speedups. Mix the requested potions, process them at the correct station and deliver the order.
